dish: Sōki soba — wide flat noodles with bone-in pork rib in bonito broth (billed as the 'original' sōki soba)
w: A Nago soba house founded in 1948 (formerly Ganaha Soba) that OTV Okitive presents as a 70-plus-year institution serving the 'original' sōki soba — flat wide noodles in a bonito-forward broth. Listed by the Nago City tourism association.

dish: Anettai brunch (choice of three toasts) and gapao rice with Yanbaru herbs, eaten in hammocks over the sea
n: Hammock Garden Anettai Chaya, Motobu (亜熱帯茶屋)
w: An Asian-style hillside café opened in May 2015 up a single-lane lane in Motobu, near Churaumi, with hammocks, arbours and mostly outdoor seats looking over forest and sea. Stars and Stripes Okinawa reviewed it for its food and coastal view; the OCVB, Mapple and Tabirai list its brunch toasts and Yanbaru-herb chicken gapao rice.

dish: Lunch plate of Okinawa-grown vegetables with house-smoked bacon
n: BLOOM HOUSE, Motobu (ブルームハウス)
w: A café in a renovated old house (60–70 years old) in Izumi, on Motobu's inland 'soba road', opened in August 2024; OTV Okitive singles out its lunch loaded with Okinawan vegetables and homemade smoked bacon. Rurubu names it among Okinawa's six best Yanbaru forest cafés.

dish: Açai bowl made without frozen fruit, poke bowls and superfood smoothies
w: A forest-hill café over the Haneji inland sea opened on 17 September 2024 by a YouTuber couple, built from glass-walled containers with a driftwood 'bird's nest' lookout and a giant swing (OTV Okitive, Tabirai). Its menu draws on the owners' world travels — açai bowls made without frozen fruit, poke bowls, smoothies and morning plates; rurubu ranks it among Okinawa's six best Yanbaru forest cafés.
